2609.27650.title: Brain-to-Language Decoding: Tasks, Signals, Methods, Evaluation, Practical Use and Beyond
2609.27650.paper_summary: Brain-to-language decoding translates neural activity associated with language production, internal speech and perception into linguistic or expressive outputs. It offers a route to restoring communication after speech loss and a means of studying how the brain represents language. Advances in neural recording and representation learning have expanded the field from constrained recognition and acoustic reconstruction to text generation, streaming personalised speech and facial animation. This survey synthesises these developments across invasive and non-invasive measurements, drawing on a search without a lower year limit and source-led updates through September 2026. We connect Articulated, Inner and Perceived tasks to the neural populations they engage, the representations available to decoders and the outputs those representations can support. We examine model development, public resources and the evolution of evaluation, and compare published performance and communication costs within their reported protocols. The synthesis identifies complementary routes to progress: phonetic, acoustic and semantic targets preserve different aspects of a message; shared representations support reuse across recording conditions and tasks; and online communication increasingly depends on calibration, feedback and user control alongside decoding accuracy. Shared benchmarks enable algorithmic comparisons, while longitudinal studies reveal the demands of sustained use. We discuss these developments and their remaining limitations, then outline a prospective five-level trajectory from commands and language to meaning, scenarios and bidirectional cognitive exchange
2609.27650.paper_summary_zh: 大腦到語言的解碼將與語言產生、內部語言和感知相關的神經活動轉換為語言或表達輸出。<lb/>這為在失去語言後恢復溝通提供了一條途徑，並且是一種研究大腦如何表現語言的手段。<lb/>神經記錄和表示學習的進展使得該領域從受限的識別和聲學重建擴展到文本生成、流式個性化語音和面部動畫。<lb/>本調查綜合了這些在侵入性和非侵入性測量中的發展，基於無下限年份的搜索和截至2026年9月的來源主導更新。<lb/>我們將發音、內部和感知任務與它們所涉及的神經群體、解碼器可用的表示以及這些表示所能支持的輸出聯繫起來。<lb/>我們檢查模型開發、公共資源和評估的演變，並比較已發表的性能和在其報告協議內的通信成本。<lb/>這一綜合體識別了進步的互補途徑：語音、聲學和語義目標保留了信息的不同方面；共享表示支持在錄音條件和任務之間的重用；而在線通信越來越依賴於校準、反饋和用戶控制以及解碼準確性。<lb/>共享基準使算法比較成為可能，而縱向研究揭示了持續使用的需求。<lb/>我們討論這些發展及其仍然存在的限制，然後概述從命令和語言到意義、情境和雙向認知交流的前景五級軌跡。
